M1-F003.name: Thực hiện cuộc gọi nội bộ PBX

M1-F004.name: Gọi khẩn cấp SOS qua GSM

M3-F003.name: Đánh dấu đã đọc / chưa đọc

nhan-vien-tmc.display_name: Nhân viên Trung tâm điều hành
nhan-vien-tmc.note: TMC operators use a separate management system. They do NOT log in to this mobile app. Their actions (create tasks, send notifications) appear as data pushed to this app via ITS API + FCM.

its-backend.note: System actor. Provides REST API for task data; receives status updates and media uploads.

pbx-system.note: System actor. Handles SIP call routing, extension presence, call history.

business_rules_enforced.rule: Task list shows ONLY tasks assigned to current user
SOS call must work WITHOUT internet (GSM only)
SOS button always visible on every screen
Auth must use HTTPS + token session
